name: Check Sky Light
description: Check Sky Light v3.6 is an empirical civilian sky diagnostics and aerospace deconfliction platform built around 4 core modules: TARGET (optical AR tracking & IMU sensor HUD), RADAR (live ADS-B aircraft, weather balloon & satellite deconfliction), ANALYZE (forensic multi-lens intelligence with CGI screening & DTC P0312 Parallax consensus), and REPORT (standardized field dossiers & PDF export). The app's core strength is its unyielding empirical discipline—screening out conventional air traffic and sensor artifacts before evaluating non-conventional physics.
